correctness.rationale: Traceless Hermitian zero-diagonal basis proves exact energy equalization for both nonzero-probability charger outcomes. Pure outcome battery states differ only in phase and an outcome-conditioned diagonal gate aligns them. Direct two-qubit evolution derives exact F± envelope. Solving the self-inclusion quadratic gives p±; concavity and F+ derivative at p+ of sqrt(1−eta)(1−2beta) prove iff beta>1/2 finite-step attainment. The equalizer and unitary formula were compared in standalone code, including 168 exact rational, 450 resonant and 250 detuned physical checks. Finite tests are not substituted for the analytic proof.
